notes: Indian umbrella organization for retail payments. Operates UPI (Unified Payments Interface — world's largest real-time payments system by volume), IMPS, RuPay (domestic card scheme), and NACH. Technical specs partly public; participant security and operational rules are members-only.

_country_provenance.note: Not verified against the organisation itself. A ccTLD implies where a domain was registered, not necessarily where the body operates — correct this field directly if it is wrong, and it will not be overwritten.
